dolcevita.style: a painterly gouache illustration of the Amalfi coast (Positano, Ravello): lemon trees, bougainvillea, white stone balustrades, pastel cliffside villages, turquoise sea, soft brushwork

stations.light: bright summer morning, pale blue sky
stations.subject: a pergola of lemons and pink bougainvillea on a white stone terrace above the turquoise sea, the bride in a white dress with a long veil and the groom in a cream suit seen from behind holding hands at the balustrade, the pastel village of Positano on the cliff

stations.light: warm late-afternoon golden light, pale gold sky
stations.subject: a small white chapel on the cliff with an arch of bougainvillea and lemon trees around its door, the bride and groom seen from behind walking toward it on a stone path, the sea below

stations.light: sunset turning to dusk, deep blue sky with a few warm pink clouds, the first stars
stations.subject: a terrace dinner under a pergola of lemons with warm string lights just lit, a long table with white linen and candles, the illuminated village and the sea at dusk behind

stations.light: blue hour night, deep indigo sky, calm
stations.subject: the calm night sea with the lights of a distant village reflected on the water, a few boats, very quiet and simple

stations.light: night with a full moon, deep blue night sky
stations.subject: a moonlit balcony with a white stone balustrade, potted lemon trees and lanterns, a cream Vespa parked, the moon reflected on the sea

oldmoney.style: a refined painterly gouache illustration of the English countryside in a quiet 'old money' style: a Georgian manor of honey-coloured stone covered in ivy, clipped boxwood and yew hedges, gravel drives, rose gardens, a vintage dark green car, soft muted greens, creams and stone tones, full-bleed painting edge to edge (not a vignette, no paper margin)

stations.light: soft bright morning, pale cream and light blue sky
stations.subject: the Georgian manor covered in ivy at the end of a gravel drive between clipped boxwood, a vintage dark green car parked in front, the bride and groom seen from behind walking toward the manor

stations.light: warm afternoon light, pale golden sky
stations.subject: a small old stone chapel with a slate roof and a bell cote in the manor park, roses climbing the porch, ancient oak trees, guests' empty wooden chairs on the lawn

stations.light: dusk turning to night, deep blue sky with the last warm glow on the horizon
stations.subject: a white marquee tent on the lawn glowing warmly from inside, long tables with candles, strings of lights in the old trees, the manor lit in the background
a still ornamental lake in the park at night reflecting the lit windows of the distant manor, a stone balustrade and topiary in silhouette, very calm

stations.light: night with a pale moon, deep navy sky
stations.subject: the manor's stone terrace at night with lanterns on the steps, the vintage green car parked below with its lights on, rose bushes

doucefrance.style: a painterly gouache illustration of Provence, in the south of France: a honey-stone bastide with pale blue shutters, lavender fields, plane trees, olive trees and cypresses, a village square with a stone fountain, warm Mediterranean light, soft brushwork, full-bleed painting edge to edge

stations.light: bright summer morning, pale blue sky
stations.subject: a honey-stone bastide with pale blue shutters surrounded by rows of lavender in bloom, olive trees and a cypress, the bride and groom seen from behind walking hand in hand along the lavender rows

stations.light: warm afternoon light, pale golden sky
stations.subject: a small Provençal village church with a stone bell tower on a square shaded by plane trees, a stone fountain, white flowers on the church door, the couple seen from behind going up the steps

stations.light: dusk turning to night, deep blue sky with the last warm glow
stations.subject: a long dinner table under the plane trees in the garden of the bastide, white linen, candles and glasses, strings of warm lights hanging in the branches, lavender in the foreground

stations.light: night, deep indigo sky with stars, calm
stations.subject: lavender fields under the starry night, a lone olive tree, the distant lights of a hilltop village, very calm and simple

stations.light: night with a full moon, deep indigo sky
stations.subject: the terrace of the bastide at night with lanterns, a wooden table with two glasses of wine, pots of lavender, the moon above the hills
